text:
alex: Quick Q — where's the dashboard for the model-serving `token latency` alert? I'm getting alerts for `model-serving-high-latency` and want to check logs/traces before paging.
oncall-bot: [alert] model-serving-high-latency fired · severity: P2 · hosts: gpu-pool-2 · avg_token_latency=320ms · threshold=250ms · alert_id=asg-47
jordan: Dashboard is at https://grafana.internal.redwood/d/abcd/model-serving?orgId=1 — panels: 95p latency, p99 latency, request rate, and tracer links. Use the top-right time picker last 15m.
jordan: For traces click the span link -> opens Tempo with trace_id from the logs panel.
maria: FYI that alert is currently routed to eng-platform PD group. Are we sure we want infra-oncall to own it? It often maps to perf regressions in model code.
kevin: It's noisy after model restarts; I think we should add a 2-min suppression during deploy and increase threshold to 300ms for now.
alex: OK — two actions: (1) where do I edit the PD mapping? (2) can someone add a runbook link to the alert so the oncall has steps?
jordan: PD mapping is in infra-config repo -> ops/pagerduty/mappings.yaml. I can open a PR to change route to `infra-oncall` and add a `runbook_url` tag. Example snippet:
```
- alert: model-serving-high-latency
  route: infra-oncall
  runbook: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/model-latency
  mute_windows:
    - after_deploy: 2m
  threshold_ms: 300
```
maria: Please don't switch routing without @sre-lead approval — platform may need to own rollouts. @sre-lead can you weigh in? :eyes:
sre-lead: Agree with keeping platform owning production regressions for model code. Proposal: keep PD route to eng-platform but add runbook + 2m suppression and raise threshold to 300ms. If it's infra-related (hardware/host) have a tag `infra=true` to auto-escalate.
infra-oncall: We can support auto-escalation if you add `escalate_to: infra-oncall` tag in mappings. Otherwise we'll just get a duplicate page.
kevin: I'll put together a small PR with the threshold + suppression + runbook and add the `infra=true` tag when appropriate. tagging @jordan for the PD mapping change review.
alex: Thanks — can someone add direct links to the Grafana panels for p95 and p99 in the runbook? saves a step for oncall.
jordan: Will do. I'll open PRs for both the alert rule (monitoring repo) and the PD mapping (infra-config) and post links here when ready. ETA 2hr. :thumbsup:
alex: Awesome. If anything goes live before that, I'll mute the alert in PagerDuty for the incident window. :+1:
maria: Thanks everyone — documented next steps in the ticket. Closing loop when PRs are merged.
